prompt:
Create pixel art of ONE building for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page. The big grey shape is exactly where the building goes: fill it edge to edge, with the building's outline on the edge of the grey shape. The darker grey upper part is the roof, the lighter grey lower part is the front wall, the dark upright block is the door and the small mid-grey block is the window. Do not copy the grey colours.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map. The building is about 192 sprite pixels wide and 192 tall; this character is about 90 sprite pixels tall. Match its sprite-pixel size exactly, its dark outlines, its flat 2-3 tone shading and its light from the upper left. The door must be tall enough for him.


Building: a small European-style village cottage seen straight from the front (the south side). Show only the front: the left and right sides of the building are straight vertical edges, with no side wall visible and no roof overhang past the sides. The top half is the roof: red-orange clay roof tiles in neat horizontal courses sloping toward the viewer, with the ridge line along the very top and the lower edge ending in a dark eave with a thin shadow line under it (no gable, no chimney, no dormer, no sign). The bottom half is the front wall: warm cream plaster with a darker base course along the bottom and slightly darker corners at the left and right. A wooden plank door with a dark frame stands in the right-centre of the wall, from about the middle of the wall down to the bottom edge; a small four-pane window with a wooden frame sits in the upper part of the wall left of the door; the rest of the wall is plain.

Draw it as one continuous illustration: no lines, seams or borders dividing the building into squares or panels; roof courses and plaster run unbroken across the whole width.
Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.
Outside the building: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no ground, no grass, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text.
